name: Progremzion WooText Change
author: Sanket Mehta

sections.description:
Progremzion WooText Change replaces the WooCommerce “Out of stock” availability
text on product pages with your own wording (default “Sold”), without editing
any WooCommerce core files.

  • Set the replacement text from Settings > WooText Change — no code required.
  • Works in any language: it matches on the product’s stock status, not on the
    English “Out of stock” string, so it applies on translated stores too.
  • Backordered products are left untouched.
  • Developers can still override the text with the progremzion_wootext_replacement
    filter.

This plugin requires WooCommerce to be installed and active.
sections.installation:
From your WordPress dashboard

  1. Go to Plugins > Add New.
  2. Search for “Progremzion WooText Change”.
  3. Click Install Now, then Activate.

From WordPress.org

  1. Download the plugin ZIP.
  2. Upload the progremzion-wootext-change directory to /wp-content/plugins/.
  3. Activate the plugin from your Plugins page.
sections.faq:
Where do I change the replacement text?

Go to Settings > WooText Change and enter your text. Leave it blank to use
the default, “Sold”.

Does it work on non-English stores?

Yes. The plugin matches the product’s stock status (“out of stock”), not the
displayed English text, so it works no matter what language your store uses.

Can I change the text in code instead?

Yes. Use the progremzion_wootext_replacement filter, for example:

add_filter( 'progremzion_wootext_replacement', function() { return 'Reserved'; } );

2.0.0

  • New: settings page (Settings > WooText Change) to set the replacement text.
  • New: language-independent matching by stock status (works on translated stores).
  • New: progremzion_wootext_replacement filter for developers.
  • Added direct-access protection and translation support.
  • Declared the WooCommerce dependency via Requires Plugins.
  • Added plugin icon, banner, and screenshots.
  • Updated tested-up-to and minimum PHP/WordPress versions.
